subject: general
question: How many countries share the international land border with India, as of 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**7**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India shares its land borders with seven countries.
 
• **Pakistan** and **Afghanistan** in the **northwest, China , Nepal,** and **Bhutan** in the **North **and **Myanmar** and **Bangladesh** in the** east.**
 
• Towards the south, India has two **neighbouring island countries - Sri Lanka and Maldives.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India's geography is incredibly diverse. It includes:
 
 
• **The Himalayan Mountain Range: **In the north, it borders with the world's highest mountain range, which includes Mount Everest and Kanchenjunga, the world's highest and third highest peaks, respectively.
 
• **Northern Plains:** South of the Himalayas, there are fertile river plains, largely fed by rivers such as the Ganges, Yamuna, and Brahmaputra. These plains are densely populated and are the agricultural hub of the country.
 
• **Thar Desert: **To the west, in the state of Rajasthan and extending into Pakistan, is the arid Thar Desert.
 
• **Central Plateau:** Further south, there is the Deccan plateau, which is flanked by the Western Ghats and Eastern Ghats, both of which are mountain ranges.
 
• **Coastal Plains:** On the western and eastern sides of the peninsula, there are narrow coastal plains that provide the country with a significant amount of coastline along the Arabian Sea and the Bay of Bengal, respectively.
 
• **Islands:** India also has several islands, the largest of which are Andaman and Nicobar in the Bay of Bengal and Lakshadweep in the Arabian Sea.
 
 
 
• These diverse geographical features contribute to India's rich biodiversity, with various ecosystems ranging from desert to rainforest, from high-altitude alpine conditions to fertile plains, and mangroves to coral reefs.
